reuse.why: Keeps getDateWithSkippedWeekend for non-daily schedules, but puts the new daily rule as an inline loop in getNextDate rather than in the shared weekend-adjustment helper the other call sites use.

duplication.why: No copied logic is added; the new loop is written once.

placement.why: The rule sits in shared/schedules.ts, but inside getNextDate only, while getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts) and schedule-template.ts apply weekend handling through their own skipWeekend ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend(...) code and still move daily weekend occurrences.

scope.why: Only getNextDate and its tests change.

maintainability.why: The daily-vs-other decision now differs between getNextDate and the other weekend-handling paths, and the 7-attempt loop with magic bound is buried in a branch; a maintainer has to know to replicate it elsewhere.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Non-daily schedules still go through getDateWithSkippedWeekend; the daily branch is new logic rather than a bypass of an existing helper.

one_place.where: Only getNextDate in shared/schedules.ts applies the daily skip; getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and createScheduleList in server/budget/schedule-template.ts still call getDateWithSkippedWeekend for every frequency.
